the_no_fetch_term_was_measured_on_the_PI.description: CTO half C3 requires the log to show 0 requests to an index. A grep for 'pypi' is the wrong object: pip logs 'Ignoring indexes: https://pypi.org/simple' precisely when it is NOT using the index, so a naive count returns 2 and reads as two requests. A zero on an unreadable log is also indistinguishable from a zero on a clean one.
the_no_fetch_term_was_measured_on_the_PI.expected_landed: request-shaped predicates are counted, each reading 0, and a phrase pip definitely writes is counted as a positive control to prove the log is readable
the_no_fetch_term_was_measured_on_the_PI.expected_not_landed: a substring count of 'pypi' reported as the request count, or a 0 reported with no control that the file was parsed at all
the_no_fetch_term_was_measured_on_the_PI.observed: First read: grep -c over a pattern including 'https://pypi' returned 2, and those 2 hits were the two 'Ignoring indexes' declarations -- caught and re-measured rather than reported. Precise read over C:/tmp/bb18-pip.log (56 lines): 'Starting new HTTPS connection' 0, 'Starting new HTTP connection' 0, 'files.pythonhosted.org' 0, 'GET /simple' 0, 'Downloading http' 0, 'urllib3' 0. Positive controls: 'Ignoring indexes' 2 and 'Local files found' 6, so the log parsed. Both pip steps end in a 'Successfully downloaded' line resolved from C:/tmp/bb18-wheels.
